day1Definition: The day DaBin is verified publicly downloadable on the Mac App Store in the intended territories.
timezone: Set the publication timezone explicitly when dates are assigned.

prelaunch.action: Nominate the actual launch for Apple featuring where practical; Apple recommends at least three weeks lead time.
Finish live-link fields, support/privacy routes, final-build comparison and fictional sample media.
Watch final exports, check captions/crops, reread platform rules and prepare a staffed launch.

days.action: Verify the live App Store listing, Free price and supported territories. Publish the landing page and one feed-film social announcement.
days.completionEvidence: Actual public availability and working links

days.action: Publish one r/macapps post if current rules and account eligibility are met. Reply to questions.
days.completionEvidence: Required disclosure, changelog and promotion timing completed

days.action: Read recent work from three relevant targets; send individually tailored pitches if chosen by the owner.
days.completionEvidence: Real relevance sentence and final live links

days.action: Check App Store Connect for campaign-link availability and record the first baseline. Keep unavailable values blank.
days.completionEvidence: Live download data; real Apple-generated links

days.action: Publish the designer project-reference example and answer one workflow question.
days.completionEvidence: Actual UI with fictional Studio Refresh data

days.action: Prepare the Product Hunt gallery and maker comment; choose a staffed publication day.
days.completionEvidence: Working app/site/support and accurate screenshots

days.action: Review week one: support questions, channel reach, available downloads and outreach responses.
days.completionEvidence: Comparable date ranges; no inferred retention

days.action: Record or finish the real saved-screenshot text-search demo using a neutral filename.
days.completionEvidence: Word appears in saved image and actual search result

days.action: Publish screenshot-search demo with one clear benefit and compatibility.
days.completionEvidence: No whole-Mac or semantic search claim

days.action: Tailor pitches to two more relevant targets, leading with the saved-screenshot workflow.
days.completionEvidence: Read recipient work and route policy

days.action: Launch on Product Hunt if ready and stay available for questions; otherwise keep it in draft.
days.completionEvidence: No upvote request; truthful personal maker identity

days.action: Answer compatibility and local-storage questions; update public FAQ if needed.
days.completionEvidence: Actual question or verified explanation

days.action: One short follow-up to first-week pitches where appropriate, with a new relevant detail.
days.completionEvidence: About a week elapsed; no decline/policy exclusion

days.action: Compare the capture and search hooks using observed metrics and qualitative replies.
days.completionEvidence: Matching reporting window and metric scope

days.action: Prepare the student use case with fictional course notes and one saved screenshot.
days.completionEvidence: Actual saved-content workflow, no study-outcome promise

days.action: Publish the student test on one suitable existing channel.
days.completionEvidence: Compatibility and searchable-saved-content limit

days.action: Read recent work and tailor pitches to two more relevant publication/creator routes.
days.completionEvidence: No claim of prior familiarity without reading

days.action: Publish a short answer to a real common question, or a factual local-search explainer.
days.completionEvidence: Only call it common if evidence exists

days.action: Prepare the developer example: documentation link, saved snippet and next task.
days.completionEvidence: No integration or code-execution claim

days.action: Publish the developer example; ask for optional workflow feedback.
days.completionEvidence: No request for private saved files

days.action: Review audience response and shortlist remaining targets. Select the strongest observed angle.
days.completionEvidence: Avoid conclusions from withheld metrics

days.action: Send up to three final high-fit organic pitches if the owner chooses; reach ten total only if appropriate.
days.completionEvidence: Route policy, real fit and no bulk send

days.action: Publish the one-project demo showing references, a note and the next task.
days.completionEvidence: Actual app view, fictional examples

days.action: Follow up once on second-week outreach where welcome; log replies or declines.
days.completionEvidence: Same thread; one follow-up maximum

days.action: Share actual independent coverage with a short accurate description if any exists; otherwise publish a useful tip.
days.completionEvidence: Actual coverage URL; no fabricated endorsement

days.action: Check website/product-page questions and improve one unclear caption or FAQ answer.
days.completionEvidence: Current shipping behavior; no unsupported new promise

days.action: Review Apple nomination draft for a real future release or enhancement; keep dates truthful.
days.completionEvidence: Real feature/date and lead time where practical

days.action: Review all campaign/date-range data and time spent; keep missing data explicit.
days.completionEvidence: Apple threshold/attribution limits recorded

days.action: Refresh the strongest demo with a new fictional example or verified answer; do not repeat a subreddit promotion early.
days.completionEvidence: Current platform rules and public build

days.action: Write a month-end observation note and choose one audience, one hook and next month's two demos.
days.completionEvidence: Observed facts only; optional paid spend requires budget decision
